deviations_from_card: One commit instead of the three the rollback names. Case 7 (guard) is two tests: fixtures, and the 60-step session. Case 8 (existing suites) is covered by the full desktop suite, not a new test. Red-before was measured against a plain stand-in memo.ts that delegated to the plain functions, since memo.ts did not exist. tapeOf now takes the turn and the last user entry as arguments instead of re-deriving them (internal, same output).
notes: Public shape for slot B: selectCompanion(i: CompanionInputs) => CompanionModel is unchanged and stays the oracle. Live now calls createCompanionSelector()(inputs), which has the same signature. If B adds an input (e.g. `via` on SessionDecision, read by recordView), it rides inside `decisions`, which is already a key of the record part, so no memo change is needed. A NEW top-level input read by a part must be added to that part's key list in memo.ts; the guard tests catch a missing key (checked by mutation). pickRun in memo.ts lists the run fields Live reads, so a new run field Live or the model reads must be added there too. No first-paint impact: live.tsx is the companion entry, not chrome.html; no zustand helper was imported. The scan of transcript identity and stepsOfTurn are still O(n) pointer scans per delta (no parsing). ADR 0185. No sibling reds seen.
